known.via: English Wikipedia "Eagle Peak Mendocino County AVA"

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A mountainous AVA in northern Mendocino County, in the Coastal Range west of Redwood Valley, about ten miles north of Ukiah. It lies within the North Coast.
